name: What security ratings should I look for in a deadbolt?

mainEntity.name: What security ratings should I look for in a deadbolt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deadbolts are rated by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) with grades from 1 to 3, indicating their security level and durability. Grade 1 offers the highest security and durability, suitable for commercial applications and primary residential entry points. Grade 2 provides good residential security, while Grade 3 is considered standard or basic. When choosing, consider the exposure and importance of the door. Maine Results, Inc. can guide you through options and recommend Grade 1 or 2 deadbolts for robust security in your Boise Heights or West Bench home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for ANSI Grade 1 (highest security) or Grade 2 deadbolts for robust home security, depending on the door's importance.
